info.title: facebook_lead_ads (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Facebook Lead Ads API via the Graph API. Lead Ads let you collect contact info from users via an instant form. To get started: create a lead form on a Page, then create an Ad that references the form. Leads submitted through the form are retrievable via the form's leads edge. Requires pages_manage_ads, ads_management, and leads_retrieval permissions.

post.description: Set up a new Lead Ad (instant form) on a Facebook Page. The form collects contact details from users who engage with the ad. Returns the ID of the newly created ad.
